title: bug: CI's windows-latest step "Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments" is red on PR #230 since edc3e937: daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs's driver requires exactly one Start-Process passing --project in moe-agent.ps1, and CQ-M07s added a second (the check-dispatch launch, moe-agent.ps1:9617), so both PowerShell rows throw "found 2"
description:
Found by architect-67c762f6 while timing suites for task-5f5c8999 (2026-11-04 ~21:30 local).

Evidence:
- Real CI: PR #230 runs 41894749395 (headSha d05e6e0b) and 41895358687 (headSha e53f5a5c, the current tip of moe/work-2026-10-24). In both, every job is green except Build (windows-latest), and its only failed step is "Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments" (`node --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs`, ci.yml, Windows only).
- Local repro: Windows node (node.exe from WSL) in a git-archive snapshot of edc3e937 on D:. `node.exe --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs` gives 13 pass, 2 fail: "PowerShell 5.1: the daemon-autostart Start-Process passes literal-name paths as whole arguments" and the same row for PowerShell 7. Both stderr lines say "expected exactly one Start-Process passing --project in moe-agent.ps1, found 2" (the driver's driver.ps1:7).

Cause:
- The DRIVER in daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs (about :55) selects every CommandAst named Start-Process whose extent text contains '--project', then requires exactly one.
- edc3e937 (task-74fe4c99, CQ-M07s) added `$script:CheckDispatchProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $Node -ArgumentList (ConvertTo-MoeArgumentLine @($script:CheckDispatchCli, '--project', ...))` at moe-agent.ps1:9617.
- The daemon autostart call itself (moe-agent.ps1:1029, `@("$daemonScript", "start", "--project", "$projectPath")`) did not change. So the selector is too broad; nothing shows that the launcher misbehaves.

Expected fix: the driver selects the daemon-autostart Start-Process by what makes it that call (for example the `$daemonScript` / "start" arguments), not by '--project' alone, and keeps its exactly-one check. The plan decides the exact selector. The launcher is changed only if the plan shows why it must be.

Why HIGH: PR #230 merges only at all-green CI, and this is the one red step at the tip.
definitionOfDone: `node.exe --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs` (Windows node, run from WSL) passes at the landing commit with both the PowerShell 5.1 and the PowerShell 7 rows run, none skipped.

The driver still selects exactly one statement, the daemon autostart Start-Process (the call that runs $daemonScript with start --project), and still fails when that call is missing or duplicated. A mutant run (a copy of moe-agent.ps1 with that call removed, and one with it duplicated) shows each failing.
scripts/moe-agent.ps1 behavior is unchanged, unless the plan justifies a launcher change; the check-dispatch Start-Process at about :9617 is not touched.
The verification command finishes within 20 min on this host (GLOBAL gate-budget rail).

implementationPlan.note: RED first (tests 4, fail 2, found 2), then applied the planned selector, AUTOSTART_COUNT, plain() and row C. File sha256 equals the planning prototype (ed65fb1a...); no raw BOM, 4 non-ASCII lines.

What it does: it runs Windows node from WSL under env -i (no MOE_/CLAUDE seat env reaches node.exe) on this one test file with the TAP reporter. It prints GATE_OK only when all of these hold:
- scripts/moe-agent.ps1 is identical to the base (MERGE_HEAD, else the merge-base with $MOE_LAND_TARGET);
- rc is 0 within 1200 s;
- `# tests 6`, `# pass 6` and `# skipped 0`;

Planning dry-run on e53f5a5c, in a sparse clone on D:: GATE_OK in 10-12 s on every run at load 5-6. RED on the unfixed file: tests 4, fail 2, found 2.
Error handling for a red run: read log=<file> (the full TAP).
- ps1diff=1: scripts/moe-agent.ps1 differs from the base. If you did not edit it, check `git log --oneline "$B"..HEAD -- scripts/moe-agent.ps1` and whether the local target is stale (`git rev-parse "$MOE_LAND_TARGET" "origin/$MOE_LAND_TARGET"`). Never edit the launcher to make the gate pass.

- 'expected one daemon-autostart line in moe-agent.ps1 to mutate': the launcher's autostart line changed shape. Stop and report it in the summary.
- A lone EPERM or EBUSY from a t.after rmSync on a PowerShell 7 row is the known cleanup race against a just-exited node.exe (mem:gotcha-heartbeat-reload-fixture-vacuity). Rerun once and cite both runs; any other failure is real.
- A skip means where.exe did not find pwsh.exe (it is the WindowsApps alias on this host). Fix the environment, not the gate.
Submit the command, its exit code and the printed tail: the ok lines, the four autostart diagnostics, the counts, the log= line and GATE_OK.

comments.content:
Governor planning input, 19:45Z.
(1) Priority is now LOW. PR #230 was merged to main red on the human's order ("merge all, we will fix ci later when all tasks done", 2026-11-04; merge commit e64646bc), so this fixes main's red Windows step. It uses idle workers only and never preempts a task row.
(2) Carried from my duplicate task-83f72d9f (archived):
- Only scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs changes; scripts/moe-agent.ps1 is untouched.
- The locator picks exactly the daemon-autostart Start-Process (e.g. by its daemon entry / `start` argument or enclosing function), unaffected by the check-dispatch call at moe-agent.ps1:9617 or any future `--project` Start-Process.
- Every assertion about that call is unchanged.
- It still fails on a mutant that breaks the autostart argument quoting.
- The gate is one run of the file through a Windows node, on PS 5.1 and 7. It must fit the 20-min rail.
- If you chain several checkRefs, wrap each in its own subshell: `( ref0 ) && ( ref1 )` (comment-0a43e151 on cb378fd8).

executionContract.intendedBehavior: On Windows node, daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs's row A driver selects exactly the daemon-autostart Start-Process: the call whose arguments hold the variable $daemonScript and the string constants start and --project. The CQ-M07s check-dispatch Start-Process (moe-agent.ps1 ~:9617) also passes --project, but it no longer trips the exactly-one check, so both PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 rows pass. A new row C per engine proves that guard: the driver run on a copy of moe-agent.ps1 with the autostart line removed fails with 'expected exactly one daemon-autostart Start-Process in moe-agent.ps1, found 0', and on a copy with it duplicated with '... found 2'. scripts/moe-agent.ps1 is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: DoD 1: checkRefs[0] (Windows node from WSL) prints GATE_OK: 6 tests, 6 pass, 0 skipped, three ok rows each for PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.

DoD 2: row C passes on both engines, and its four TAP diagnostics show the removed copy stopping at 'found 0' and the duplicated copy at 'found 2'; reverting the selector to --project alone, or dropping the exactly-one check, turns the gate red (planning mutants).
DoD 3: git diff against the base is empty for scripts/moe-agent.ps1 (ps1diff=0); only scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs changes.
DoD 4: the gate reports secs well under 1200 (10-12 s measured in planning).
invariants: scripts/moe-agent.ps1 stays byte-identical: the autostart (~:1029) and the check-dispatch Start-Process (~:9617) are not touched.
The driver still throws unless exactly one Start-Process matches, and still runs that call's extent text once per case.
No test-only knob or env var is added to the launcher or the test.
compatibility: ci.yml:325-328 (windows-latest 'Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments': node --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs) is unchanged and picks up row C.
Non-Windows node: every row of the file still skips with the existing reason; row C inherits opts.
Rows A and B keep their fixtures and assertions; only the driver's selection predicate and its count message change.

scripts/moe-agent.ps1:9617 (Invoke-MoeCheckDispatchChild): Start-Process -FilePath $Node -ArgumentList (ConvertTo-MoeArgumentLine @($script:CheckDispatchCli, '--project', "$projectPath", '--task', $preflightTaskId, '--commit', $Frozen.Commit)); there is no $daemonScript and no 'start'.
scripts/moe-agent.ps1:9467: the seat CLI Start-Process passes no --project literal; :848, :1026 and :9950 are comments.

On PowerShell 5.1 and 7, Ast.FindAll visits the VariableExpressionAst nested in the ExpandableStringExpressionAst "$daemonScript", and "start" parses as a StringConstantExpressionAst (verified on this host 2026-11-04, powershell.exe 5.1 and the pwsh.exe 7.6.9 WindowsApps alias).
Node 24 on CI (ci.yml node-version '24') and on this host (node.exe v24.16.0): Array.prototype.toSpliced is available; node.exe's TAP output has no CR.
checkRefs: ( cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && B=$(git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD || git merge-base HEAD "${MOE_LAND_TARGET:-HEAD}") && L=$(mktemp /tmp/e521-gate.XXXXXX) || exit 9; git diff --quiet "$B" -- scripts/moe-agent.ps1; d=$?; s=$SECONDS; env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs:/usr/bin:/bin" node.exe --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs >"$L" 2>&1; r=$?; t=$((SECONDS-s)); grep -E '^(not )?ok |^# (tests|pass|fail|skipped) |^# autostart ' "$L"; echo "log=$L base=$B ps1diff=$d rc=$r secs=$t"; [ $d$r = 00 ] && [ $t -lt 1200 ] && grep -qx '# tests 6' "$L" && grep -qx '# pass 6' "$L" && grep -qx '# skipped 0' "$L" && [ "$(grep -c '^ok [0-9]* - PowerShell 5\.1: ' "$L")$(grep -c '^ok [0-9]* - PowerShell 7: ' "$L")$(grep -c '^# autostart .*, found [02]$' "$L")" = 334 ] && echo GATE_OK )

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Chosen: an AST predicate that keys on what makes the call the autostart: $daemonScript among its variables, plus the string constants start and --project. It is quote-style-agnostic and keeps the exactly-one check.
- Rejected: an Extent.Text match on the literal argument list. It is brittle to whitespace and quote style, and would be a second near-miss of the same kind.
- Rejected: 'start' alone. The check dispatch could one day gain a 'start' argument.
- Rejected: changing the launcher, for example reshaping the check-dispatch call. DoD 3 forbids it and the launcher is correct. Touching moe-agent.ps1 would also contest it with the WORKING agy-port rows (task-c199e177, task-cb378fd8), which edit that file.
- Rejected: a one-off sed mutant run inside the checkRef. Permanent row C keeps the exactly-one guard proven on every PR's Windows job, and QA's re-run stays the same single command. The row costs about 1.5 s per engine.
- Rejected: a stdout count marker. The established pattern (subagent-mirror.test.mjs) asserts on the thrown error text after plain(), which proves the count check, not another failure, stopped the driver.
- task.isEpicFinal is the order fallback on this bucket epic: it has no finalTaskId and 316 siblings. The GLOBAL gate-budget rail (20 min; run only the suites that exercise the changed code; the nightly runs everything) outranks the skill's epic-final full regression. The only changed code is this Windows-only test file, so the gate runs it on both Windows engines. PR #230's Windows CI job is the broader check after landing.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Start-Process sites in moe-agent.ps1: :1029 is the daemon autostart; :9467 is the seat CLI (no --project); :9617 is the CQ-M07s check dispatch (passes '--project'); :848, :1026 and :9950 are comments.
- The old predicate `$n.Extent.Text.Contains('--project')` matched both :1029 and :9617, hence 'found 2' since edc3e937.
- PowerShell variable names and -contains are case-insensitive.
- The DRIVER is a JS template literal, so ${ interpolates and a backtick ends it.
- moe-agent.ps1 is UTF-8 with a BOM and LF line endings (.gitattributes `* text=auto eol=lf`, also on CI). Node's readFileSync keeps U+FEFF at index 0, so split/join on the newline character preserves both, and PS 5.1 parses the copies (the prototype run proves it).
- No doc describes this driver's selector, so no docs change.
- QA in the control checkout: MOE_LAND_TARGET is unset there, so B=HEAD and ps1diff is vacuous. Check DoD 3 with `git diff --stat <sha>^ <sha>`. If the control HEAD has moved past the completion and later commits touch scripts/moe-agent.ps1 or this test, run the checkRef in a `git clone --shared` on /mnt/d detached at the sha, with MOE_LAND_TARGET=<sha>^. Windows node needs a D: or C: cwd.
- Planning artifacts live in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e521-plan.x8b3/: intended.diff, the finished test file, gate.txt (the checkRef bytes), mut.mjs (mutants), head.log (RED) and fix.log (GREEN). A sparse dry-run clone is at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e521-clone.A1BX/repo.
planningNotes.risks:
- The editing tools, and moe tool string arguments, turn a 4-hex-digit backslash-u escape into the raw character (mem:gotcha-write-tool-unicode-escapes, mem:gotcha-plan-text-unicode-escapes-decoded). Row C's BOM must be typed as the code-point form with braces, and step 1's greps catch a raw BOM.
- The EPERM cleanup race on a PowerShell 7 row under heavy load: rerun once (mem:gotcha-heartbeat-reload-fixture-vacuity). It was not seen in any of the 11 planning runs at load 5-6, and row C starts no node.exe, so it adds no race.
- CI's pwsh 7 ConciseView wraps at about 120 columns. The count message is 77 characters, and plain() handles a wrap anyway.
- A stale local target can make ps1diff falsely red in the worktree. Diagnose it with git log/rev-parse; never edit the launcher.
- A later reformat of the autostart call (multi-line, single quotes, or args moved into a variable) makes row C's line anchor or the AST selector fail loudly. That is intended: the line under test changed.
- only-daemonScript (dropping the start/--project literals) survives as a mutant, by design: no other Start-Process runs $daemonScript, so no extra fixture is warranted.

completionSummary: Fixed main's red Windows CI step by changing only scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs (+39/-5). The driver now selects the daemon-autostart Start-Process by its AST (CommandAst Start-Process holding variable $daemonScript plus string constants 'start' and '--project') instead of '--project' alone, so the CQ-M07s check dispatch no longer counts; the exactly-one check is kept via AUTOSTART_COUNT. New row C per engine runs the driver on copies of moe-agent.ps1 with the autostart removed (stops at 'found 0') and duplicated ('found 2'). DoD1: 6 ok rows, skipped 0, both PS 5.1 and 7. DoD2: four autostart diagnostics, plus planning mutants (old-selector, no-exactly-one, pwsh-skipped, ps1-touched all red). DoD3: ps1diff=0, scope diff is one file; moe-agent.ps1 and ci.yml untouched. DoD4: secs=10 (RED before the fix: tests 4, fail 2, found 2).
